purpose: Measure whether a frozen learned opponent policy preserves fixed-action continuation comparisons against actual reference search on fresh, outcome-independent public roots. Diagnostic fidelity, not playing-strength qualification.
focal_seats: Every seat, every rule, every deal at every count.
root_policy: Frozen-1 plus the existing strict fueled-output-loss filter, against actual search_geo16 opponents. No learned surrogate influences root generation or selection.
root_sampling: Retain one eligible decision per game and phase: minimum SHA256 of JSON [root seed, episode, phase, focal decision ordinal]. Record all eligible ranks before selection. Ranking uses no state features, model scores, teacher values or game outcome. Missing eligible phases are explicitly reported and never replaced using outcomes.
eligibility: At least two legal choices; plant, bid or building phase; at least one public shortlist action different from the filtered focal action and not forbidden by the existing loss certificate.
fixed_action_pair: Filtered focal action first; then the eligible public-shortlist alternative with highest existing economic action feature 74, with lowest legal index breaking ties. Freeze pairs with roots, before evaluating any surrogate or continuation outcome.

continuations.pairing: Use the same public seed, sampled deck world and action pair in each mode. Both prior sealed-bid beliefs and future opponent play vary with mode; record earlier-bid counts and report roots without prior bids separately. Do not attribute the joint intervention to either component alone.
continuations.surrogate: Require the independently audited model selected and frozen using validation only. No selection or tuning on these roots or their continuation results.
continuations.caps: Retain all incomplete results, report the experiment incomplete, and do not assign terminal credits to caps or silently drop failed roots. No automatic retries or smaller substitute budget.

analysis.primary: Equal count/rule/phase macro mean absolute error in the alternative-minus-focal paired terminal-credit margin, using actual reference search as diagnostic reference. Compare the frozen surrogate and original population mixture without selecting a policy on these results.
secondary: Per count/rule/phase errors and adverse cells
Signed margin error and action-preference agreement, retaining ties
Roots with and without earlier sealed bids
Wall time, CPU time, memory and nested search work
analysis.uncertainty: Preserve paired world results. Cluster comparisons by whole player-count/deal, keeping all seats, rules and phases together; only two independent deals per count. Report this limited support and within-root sampling uncertainty. Simulated credits are not calibrated live-game win probabilities.
analysis.next: Use fidelity findings to design a separate heterogeneous hybrid policy and cautious override rule, then freeze and evaluate on fresh full games. These roots are not optimal-action labels.

runtime_admission: Run measured root-collection and reference-continuation calibration before selecting HF job sizes/timeouts. The fixed scientific sample count is not a runtime admission.
